svg.title: NepDate
svg.desc: 1.0 release candidate. Bikram Sambat, the Nepali calendar, wherever software needs it. One dataset and one spec, so every language gives the same day for the same date. I wrote the ports for 13 languages and co-maintain the C# original by Raju Prasai. C# · TypeScript · Python · PHP · Java · Dart · Kotlin · Go · Swift · C++ · C · Rust · Ruby · Zig
